document.title: Statement of Work
document.place_of_performance: Remote delivery by the AIS Microsoft Solution Center team with virtual client working sessions.

background: Blue Yonder Research Foundation wants a repeatable digital workspace for cross-institution research coordination.
objectives: Deliver a reference workspace that demonstrates the pattern.

in_scope.title: Architecture sprint
in_scope.description: Run MSC-led design sessions and document the approved collaboration architecture.

in_scope.title: Reference implementation
in_scope.description: Build and demonstrate a representative collaboration workspace.

out_of_scope.title: Production migration
out_of_scope.description: Migration of active research content into production is excluded.

deliverables.title: Collaboration architecture
deliverables.description: Decision-oriented architecture package for the reference solution.
acceptance_criteria: Client confirms the package covers identity, information structure, and governance decisions.

deliverables.title: Reference workspace
deliverables.description: Demonstrable workspace aligned to the approved architecture.
acceptance_criteria: The agreed research coordination scenario is demonstrated end to end.

ais.title: MSC delivery
ais.description: AIS Microsoft Solution Center will lead design and reference implementation activities.

client.title: Research participation
client.description: Client will provide research representatives and return design decisions within two business days after each design review.

assumptions.title: Reference tenant
assumptions.description: Client will provide a suitable non-production environment for the reference workspace.

notes: Commercial terms will be completed through the AIS commercial review process.
